subject: Substitution approval requested: an ABS DWV alternate in lieu of the no-hub cast-iron

messages.text: Attached is the cut sheet and third-party listing for an ABS DWV alternate in lieu of the no-hub cast-iron soil piping specified in Section 22 13 16 -- please confirm it's acceptable. We would like this reviewed before the fixture rough-in gets underway. A response by the end of the day would let us keep the order on track. This RFI is unrelated to the pending material cost-escalation claim submitted separately.

The substitution -- an ABS DWV alternate in lieu of the no-hub cast-iron soil piping specified in Section 22 13 16 -- does not meet the specified performance requirements; please resubmit with a compliant option. No schedule impact is anticipated from this substitution.
